market_question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (LOW) $40 by end of June?
reasoning: WTI crude oil at ~$65 would need a 38% drop to reach $40. Over 15 months, historical volatility and tail events (recessions, supply shocks) suggest this probability is roughly 8%, far above the market's 1.1%. Even with settlement‑based resolution, the gap is too wide.
evidence_points: WTI front‑month settlement has fallen below $40 multiple times in the past decade (2015‑2016, 2020).
At a current price near $65 and annualized volatility ~30‑35%, the probability of hitting $40 in 15 months is not negligible (z‑score ~1.2‑1.6).
Macro risks (trade wars, recession, OPEC+ discipline erosion) increase the chance of a major drawdown.
sources_consulted: Historical WTI settlement prices from CME
Implied volatilities from oil options markets (OVX)
General macro analysis of crude oil supply‑demand
